level_zero_contract: level 0 is the source asset itself: no variant asset exists for it, `identity=true`/`bytes_unchanged=true` are recorded in the run report and the source asset id is `source_asset_id`

retrieval_role.different_source_same_level: the hardest negatives of the robustness evaluation; a same-instance hit under mismatched degradation must still rank above them
retrieval_role.must_not_enter: the mate-task negative pool (R1/R0): two variants of one source are the same instance, so counting them as negatives would inject label noise
retrieval_role.same_source_different_level: same physical fragment under two degradation levels -> a same-instance positive (degradation invariance), never a mate-task positive
